title: jsonwebtoken major upgrade that rejects small keys
description: A project on jsonwebtoken 8.5.1 and the published advisory CVE-2022-23540 (fixed in 9.0.0). The fix is a major release, which the policy allows. Version 9 refuses RSA keys under 2048 bits, and the project's development keys are 1024 bits, so the fix needs an edit to the project's own source.
